who: the storyteller: a deep, heavy, grave, low male voice with a little gravel - a man in his fifties quietly telling a true incident late at night. Natural, conversational speech, steady and a little slow, every word clear. NOT theatrical, NOT sing-song, NOT like jatra or stage drama: no musical rise and fall, no exaggerated stress, no singing tone
